platform: Windows x86_64; dev profile; ONNX Runtime CPU provider, two intra-op threads
matching: Maximum one-to-one exact MIDI pitch; 50/100 ms onset; offset tolerance max(50 ms, 20% duration). Coincident same-pitch references unioned within 12 ms.
source_note: Original deterministic composer pairs and controlled synthesis of Mutopia Ode to Joy SATB; no commercial/acoustic-recording accuracy claim; no benchmark audio redistributed in the repository.

selection.rule: Select parameters on development and validation; keep held-out seeds and existing score out of selection. Reduce FP and FN on validation rather than maximize F1 alone.

rejected_validation.reason: More missing notes despite higher F1.
No overall omission improvement and one more mixture omission.

limitations: Held-out mixtures: FN 202 -> 203, despite FP 189 -> 105. Gains are not uniform.
Two validation city-pop mixture cases have lower onset F1; full per-case results are retained.
Mixed existing-score input still misses 115 of 238 reference events at 50 ms.
No independent acoustic/commercial recordings, singer separation or piano playability evaluation.
